skins.name: Echo of the Horrorlair
skins.code: Witch Feast Role-Playing Script "Horrorlair's Enigma" Custom Line/Echo of the Horrorlair
skins.description: The actor plays the role of the Horrorlair's incarnation, patrolling its corridors and keeping it safe from the patronage of thieves.

skins.name: Fated Hero
skins.code: Witch Feast Role-Playing Script "Horrorlair's Enigma" Custom Line/Fated Hero
skins.description: The actor plays the role of the hero chosen by fate, who descends into the Horrorlair not just to quell disaster and eliminate evil, but with the hope of finding treasures to improve her life.

skins.name: Grave Thief
skins.code: Witch Feast Role-Playing Script "Horrorlair's Enigma" Custom Line/Grave Thief
skins.description: The actor plays the role of the first enemy the hero faces. If defeated, she will offer her service as a merchant.

skins.name: Moon Catastrborn
skins.code: Witch Feast Role-Playing Script "Horrorlair's Enigma" Custom Line/Moon Catastrborn
skins.description: The actor plays the role of the heir of bane who descends upon Terra after rending the moon into twins. The hero stands no chance in a head-on fight.
